name: Quiet Joy Sajjada
summary: A softly curved prayer rug shelters a small warm light, carrying Quiet Joy into a place for salah.
why: Rounded corners and a short, gently splayed fringe give the rug a soft textile character. Inside, a warm light rests over the same welcoming curve that defines Quiet Joy. The pointed niche makes the place for salah clear.
risk: The compact rug may also read as a small protective emblem; the fringe and niche make the prayer connection clearer at launcher size.

palette.name: QUIET JOY / IVORY + JADE + WARM GOLD
